scope: Biomedical integration, identifiers, provenance, representation, missingness and versioning
review_type: Focused primary-source and official-artifact evidence map; not an exhaustive systematic review

sources.title: Pharos 2023: an integrated resource for the understudied human proteome
sources.checked_claim: Target-centered integration and identifier harmonization; heterogeneous sources and disease-ontology aggregation.
sources.limits: Historical resource description is not a deployed-version guarantee or validation of individual claims.
sources.project_relevance: Use full scoped Pharos as the baseline; test record-level novelty.
sources.reuse_status: Paper passages inspected; local previous construction audit read; no new build or API test.
sources.license_status: Underlying source licenses not collectively verified; paper access does not license all data.

sources.title: Pharos400 Release Notes and TDL Updates
sources.checked_claim: Canonical versus expanded protein identity, UniProt anchoring, TDL criteria and canonical319-to400 comparison.
sources.limits: Release notes do not establish the version or complete evidence contents of our GraphQL endpoint.
sources.project_relevance: Audit canonical transitions before importing expanded products.
sources.reuse_status: Release notes inspected; tables not downloaded, API migration not tested.

sources.title: Biolink Model: A universal schema for knowledge graphs in clinical, biomedical, and translational science
sources.type: peer-reviewed schema paper and official specification
sources.checked_claim: Shared categories and predicates; retrieval-source fields encode upstream resource chains and record URLs.
sources.limits: Interoperability does not establish truth or experimental independence.
sources.project_relevance: Map local semantics explicitly and preserve aggregator roles.
sources.reuse_status: Paper abstract/indexed passages and specification inspected; no pinned-version conformance audit.
sources.license_status: Implementation license not verified in this review.

sources.title: A Simple Standard for Sharing Ontological Mappings (SSSOM)
sources.type: peer-reviewed standard paper and versioned documentation
sources.checked_claim: Explicit mapping predicates and provenance distinguish semantic correspondence from bare cross-references.
sources.limits: Serializing a mapping does not verify its precision or correctness.
sources.project_relevance: Version and qualify crosswalk decisions; avoid broad-match entity merges.
sources.reuse_status: 1.0 introduction and repository inspected; no conversion executed.
sources.license_status: Repository declares BSD-3-Clause with explicit banner-image exception.

sources.title: Prediction and curation of missing biomedical identifier mappings with Biomappings
sources.checked_claim: SSSOM files separate curated positive, negative, unsure and automatically predicted mappings.
sources.limits: Our entity coverage and mapping accuracy are unmeasured.
sources.project_relevance: Existing curated mappings and counterexamples precede custom lexical merging.
sources.reuse_status: Paper indexed abstract and official README inspected; package/data not frozen or run.
sources.license_status: MIT code; primary and derived mapping data CC0 per official README.

sources.title: Translator NodeNormalization
sources.checked_claim: Inspected GET normalization defaults enable gene/protein and drug/chemical conflation.
sources.limits: Current-branch code is not a verified deployed-service or compendium version.
sources.project_relevance: Explicit settings, taxa and original IDs are necessary for protein-specific claims.
sources.reuse_status: README and server implementation inspected; no API calls or install.
sources.license_status: Repository identifies MIT; compendium source rights not audited.

sources.title: PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.checked_claim: Entities, activities, agents and derivations provide interoperable provenance representation.
sources.limits: Provenance does not infer missing origin or independence.
sources.project_relevance: Link snapshots, mappings, transformations and review revisions explicitly.
sources.reuse_status: Recommendation inspected; no formal PROV export or conformance check performed.
sources.license_status: W3C document-use terms linked by recommendation; no data-license inheritance.

sources.title: Systematic integration of biomedical knowledge prioritizes drugs for repurposing
sources.checked_claim: An integrated graph supported a specified drug-repurposing evaluation with external treatment sets.
sources.limits: Prediction performance is not validation of every graph edge or a current cancer-claim reference.
sources.project_relevance: Separate construction, downstream evaluation and source rights.
sources.reuse_status: Paper and graph repository inspected; historical v1.0 not imported.
sources.license_status: Original repository content CC0; source-specific licenses retained per node/edge where defined.

sources.title: Building a knowledge graph to enable precision medicine
sources.checked_claim: Harmonized construction and rebuild artifacts; current README directs users to successor OptimusKG.
sources.limits: Graph availability and deduplication are not source-independence or accuracy guarantees.
sources.project_relevance: Use construction recipes, audit overlap, and avoid treating reverse edges as new evidence.
sources.reuse_status: Paper methods and current README inspected; no build or successor adoption.
sources.license_status: MIT software explicitly separate from source/dataset rights.

sources.title: An open source knowledge graph ecosystem for the life sciences
sources.type: peer-reviewed framework and benchmark resource paper
sources.checked_claim: Alternative semantic representations and benchmark builds; authors disclose qualitative comparison limitations.
sources.limits: No same-input execution comparison establishing superiority; current-runtime compatibility untested.
sources.project_relevance: Make graph representation an explicit experimental variable.
sources.reuse_status: Paper, README and setup.py inspected; no installation or build.
sources.license_status: Apache-2.0 code; individual input data rights not audited.

sources.title: Introduction to GO annotations
sources.checked_claim: Open-world missingness, explicit relation/polarity and distinct NOT semantics.
sources.limits: Annotation interpretation depends on relation, context and release; NOT is not generic experimental non-significance.
sources.project_relevance: Retain conservative annotations until omitted relation/negation/extensions are recovered.
sources.reuse_status: Official semantic guidance inspected; ontology/GAF release not selected or downloaded.
sources.license_status: Specific release redistribution terms not verified in this review.

sources.title: Open Targets association scoring and data pipeline documentation
sources.checked_claim: Source-aware harmonic association scores are availability-based heuristics, not confidence probabilities.
sources.limits: Source predictions and propagated associations need qualification; scores do not establish clinical truth.
sources.project_relevance: Use as a comparison for transparent aggregation, not an imported common-confidence scale.
sources.reuse_status: Scoring and pipeline documentation inspected; no release or parser executed.
sources.license_status: Specific code/data reuse license not verified.

sources.title: Gilda: biomedical entity text normalization with machine-learned disambiguation as a service
sources.checked_claim: Contextual grounding supports custom resources; paper states default gene/protein synonym merging.
sources.limits: Grounding performance is not relation or claim correctness; resource/data overlap needs audit.
sources.project_relevance: Test constrained grounding before custom fuzzy resolution; separate biological identities deliberately.
sources.reuse_status: Paper, README and Python >=3.8 packaging inspected; no install/model download.
sources.license_status: BSD-2-Clause code; underlying resource rights not collectively audited.

sources.title: Unifying the identification of biomedical entities with the Bioregistry
sources.checked_claim: Registry harmonizes namespace metadata and prefix/resolver conventions.
sources.limits: Valid syntax and resolution do not establish entity equivalence or evidence accuracy.
sources.project_relevance: Separate prefix normalization from semantic mapping and source verification.
sources.reuse_status: Paper indexed primary text and official README inspected; no pinned package/runtime test.
sources.license_status: MIT code; curated registry portions CC0; aggregated data retain original licenses.
